environment.postgres_isolation: New loopback-only, tmpfs-only disposable container; no host mounts or volumes; per-case private schema.

limitations: This is a source/worktree test checkpoint, not an immutable candidate/release or running-deployment acceptance.
Browser Engine responses are mocked; real LAN teacher/student TLS, trust changes, version skew and network partitions are not exercised.
No real SSH deployment, package install, current-source kernel attach/event/detach, VM isolation or escape-resistance acceptance was performed.
Async event persistence queue/restart/failover consistency remains unproven; the new SQL test covers partial-cache deletion and read flags only.
Local script atomic rename is not fsync/power-loss durability or cross-process coordination; SQL script fault/cancellation semantics beyond existing tests are unchanged.
Established volatile auth fallback is retained and cannot discover unobserved cross-process revocation during an outage.
The two performance-only cases were not run; functional WebSocket pressure does not constitute a release-profile benchmark.
Cancelled enrollment can leave an already-committed account; its consumed invitation does not become reusable.
